criterion: present in the corpus under both surviving conditions (D and P) at freeze time. Coverage, never outcome.
note: Held constant across waves. Adding a model starts a SHORTER series for it; it does not retroactively join the existing one. Removing one because it was retired is a fact about the vendor and must be recorded, not deleted.
